answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in bridge and beacon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the anchor graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1699 impostors cost 809 times the honest price and take 16 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
